benchmarking.title: Club Benchmarking
benchmarking.subtitle: What Winning Investment Clubs Do Differently

clubs_researched.name: BetterInvesting National Network
clubs_researched.strategy: Stock Study methodology — standardized 5-year EPS growth analysis before any purchase vote
clubs_researched.tool: BetterInvesting Stock Study tool + member portfolio tracker
clubs_researched.takeaway: Formal written thesis required before any buy vote eliminates emotional decisions

clubs_researched.name: Spelman College Investment Club
clubs_researched.strategy: Sector rotation with quarterly rebalancing; dedicated research leads per sector
clubs_researched.tool: Google Sheets portfolio tracker + Yahoo Finance screener
clubs_researched.takeaway: Assigning sector ownership creates accountability and deeper expertise per member

clubs_researched.name: Howard University Investment Club
clubs_researched.strategy: ESG-screened portfolio with dual focus on returns and community impact metrics
clubs_researched.tool: Morningstar ESG ratings + Bloomberg terminal access via alumni network
clubs_researched.takeaway: Aligning investment thesis with community values drives member engagement and retention

steps: Create a 1-page thesis template (ticker, thesis, risks, price target, time horizon)
Require submission 48 hours before any buy/sell vote
Archive all theses in shared Google Drive for review
Assign each member 1–2 sectors to monitor monthly
Sector lead presents a 5-minute update at each meeting
Rotate assignments every 6 months for cross-training
Schedule dedicated quarterly sessions (separate from regular meetings)
Review each holding against original thesis
Vote on rebalancing with full group quorum required

key_insights: Top clubs win on process, not stock picks — build the decision framework first
ESG alignment with Black community values could be a powerful recruitment tool for FI Community
Written thesis requirement is the single highest-ROI process change available

side_income.title: Side Income & Business Moves
side_income.subtitle: Specific Opportunities This Week

opportunities.name: High-Yield Savings Account (HYSA)
opportunities.how_to_start: Open a Marcus by Goldman Sachs or Ally Bank account online in 10 minutes. Transfer club operating cash and emergency reserves.

opportunities.name: Treasury Bills via TreasuryDirect
opportunities.how_to_start: Create a free TreasuryDirect.gov account. Purchase 4-week or 13-week T-bills at auction. Minimum purchase: $100.

opportunities.name: Covered Call Writing on AAPL
opportunities.how_to_start: If club holds 100+ shares of AAPL, sell 1 covered call contract per 100 shares. Strike: 5–10% out of money. Expiry: 30 days. Collect premium regardless of outcome.

opportunities.name: Dividend Reinvestment (DRIP) Optimization
opportunities.potential_return: Accelerates compounding on SCHD and O positions
opportunities.how_to_start: Enable automatic DRIP on SCHD and O in your brokerage. All dividends auto-purchase fractional shares. No action needed month to month.

news_hooks.action: Move idle cash from checking to HYSA this week

news_hooks.action: Evaluate covered call strategy on any holding with 100+ shares

key_insights: Idle cash earning 0% in checking is a silent drag — HYSA is a 15-minute fix
T-bills currently outperform most bond funds with zero credit risk
DRIP compounding on SCHD turns a 3.5% yield into 4%+ effective return over 5 years
